findings.summary: Candidate (ESP32 3-class) retrained on the grid regenerated with the discontinuous-conduction converter at 1000 substeps (AI-N27 option 2, S-21 corrected), same recipe and same split as the promoted run. Not promoted; the registry is unchanged.
Trained and evaluated on simulated data only (speed x severity x noise x plant-drift grid, DC plant with dcm x1000); no real-machine validation exists.
3 classes (inner_race, normal, outer_race): a ball or cage fault is assigned to one of the 3 known classes, probably with high confidence; no OOD method catches it (AI-N13).

Not promoted: did not meet the pre-registered criterion. Its int8 TFLite collapses on outer_race (recall 0.38 on the dcm test split, 0.05 on the held-out affected-regime runs, 0.21 on the generalization set; Keras 0.76 / 0.31 / 0.90). Int8 quantization fragility: AI-N28.
